title: OMPx Contract — Price Manipulation via Repeated purchase/buyBack Analysis
root_cause: `purchase()`/`buyBack()` functions calculate exchange rate based on internal ETH balance — repeated calls accumulate rate imbalance enabling arbitrage profit
other_code:
Attacker
  │
  ├─[1]─► Balancer Flash Loan: borrow 100 WETH
  │
  ├─[2]─► Convert WETH → ETH
  │
  ├─[3]─► 7-iteration loop:
  │         ├─► purchase(): buy OMPX at current price
  │         └─► buyBack(): receive ETH refund exploiting price imbalance
  │               └─► small price discrepancy accumulates each iteration
  │
  ├─[4]─► Convert accumulated profit ETH → WETH
  │
  ├─[5]─► Repay Balancer flash loan (including fee)
  │
  └─[6]─► Total loss: ~4.37 ETH
